about: Mochi's recorded sounds. Each clip: file (in this folder), kind (mew | meow | chirp | sleepy | purr), optional gain (default 1). Only use recordings you may use commercially (CC0, or CC BY with the credit listed below). See README.md. Made from sources/audio by tools/audio/prepare.py. Clips with "status": "candidate" play in the preview only; remove the status once a clip is approved for the live app. "reference" clips are never played; they're only shown in the review pack for comparison.
